description: A modular desktop companion connected to your local Codex CLI

scripts.smoke:real: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --real-smoke
scripts.smoke:models: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --model-smoke
scripts.smoke:history: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --history-smoke
scripts.smoke:pointer: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --pet-pointer-smoke
scripts.smoke:floating: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --floating-smoke
scripts.smoke:timing: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --timing-smoke
scripts.smoke:performance: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --performance-smoke
scripts.smoke:delete: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --delete-smoke
scripts.smoke:buddy: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --buddy-features-smoke

scripts.smoke:stability: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --stability-smoke
scripts.smoke:resources: npm run build && node scripts/interactive-smoke.cjs app --resource-smoke
